content.unit.simit.name: Bagel
content.unit.simit.flavor: One ring, one morning. Throw it — it comes back.
content.unit.manti.name: Dumpling
content.unit.manti.flavor: Forty fit on one spoon. One is enough for you.
content.unit.pide.name: Flatcake
content.unit.borek.name: Strudel
content.unit.borek.flavor: Forty layers. Every punch takes one, never all.
content.unit.misir.name: Popcorn
content.unit.misir.flavor: Throws its kernel. Pops when it heats up.
content.unit.kestane.name: Chestnut
content.unit.kestane.flavor: Wait for the shell to crack. Then run.
content.unit.sis.name: Skewer
content.unit.sis.flavor: Turns and turns over the fire — one day, it comes down.
content.unit.kofte.name: Meatball
content.unit.kofte.flavor: Kneaded by hand, hardened by fire. Your turn.
content.unit.aycicegi.name: Sunbloom
content.unit.aycicegi.flavor: Follows the sun. You’d better be watched too.
content.unit.bamya.name: Okra
content.unit.bamya.flavor: Small, green, and nobody’s favorite. It knows.
content.unit.kabak.name: Squash
content.unit.patlican.name: Eggplant
content.unit.patlican.flavor: Held up over coals, held up in the pan. Used to a punch.
content.unit.nar.name: Garnet
content.unit.nar.flavor: The moment you open it, everything scatters. Seed by seed.
content.unit.zeytin.name: Olive
content.unit.zeytin.flavor: Small and black. Bite once and you’ll understand.
content.unit.karpuz.name: Melon
content.unit.karpuz.flavor: Heaviest of the family. You can’t lift it — don’t try.
content.unit.pastirma.name: Pastrami
content.unit.pastirma.flavor: Thick-cured, long-cured. Sold by the kilo, strikes by the slice.
content.unit.cay.name: Tea
content.unit.cay.flavor: Slim glass, thin waist. Comes hot, goes hot.
content.unit.kahve.name: Coffee
content.unit.kahve.flavor: Owed forty years of gratitude. Something’s written in the grounds, too.
content.unit.lokum.name: Delight
content.unit.lokum.flavor: Soft. The more you hit it, the deeper you sink.
content.unit.dondurma.name: Sundae
content.unit.dondurma.flavor: Made by being churned, over and over. So will you be.
content.unit.sirke.name: Vinegar
content.unit.sirke.flavor: Made by souring. With patience, and a little spite.
content.unit.tursu.name: Pickle
content.unit.tursu.flavor: Waited in the brine. Your turn.
content.unit.kuflupeynir.name: Stilton
content.unit.kuflupeynir.flavor: Mold isn’t a flaw. This time, it’s a plan.
content.unit.tarhana.name: Cracker
content.unit.tarhana.flavor: Already cracked, already dried. What more can you do to it?
content.unit.balkavanozu.name: Honey Jar
content.unit.korkuluk.name: Scarecrow
content.unit.korkuluk.flavor: It guards the patch. The birds already know — you’ll learn.
content.origin.hamur.name: Dough
content.origin.hamur.description: Dough divides. It multiplies as you win.
content.origin.ocak.name: Hearth
content.origin.ocak.description: The hearth cooks. Raw goes in, seared comes out.
content.origin.bostan.name: Garden
content.origin.bostan.description: The garden grows. And the garden has a guardian.
content.origin.pazar.name: Market
content.origin.pazar.description: The market knows its accounts. Every fallen body has a price.
content.origin.ikram.name: Treat
content.origin.ikram.description: A treat can’t be refused. One plate, one fewer enemy.
content.origin.kuf.name: Mold
content.origin.kuf.description: Mold spreads. Standing close together is a bad idea.
content.role.nisanci.name: Marksman
content.role.nisanci.description: The marksman warms up. Every hit speeds up the next.
content.role.suikastci.name: Assassin
content.role.suikastci.description: The assassin finishes. It sees the wounded and ends it.
content.role.oncu.name: Vanguard
content.role.oncu.description: The vanguard stands in front. Shield goes first, then health.
content.role.dovuscu.name: Brawler
content.role.dovuscu.description: The brawler heats up. Unbreakable, and tougher the lower its health.
